Online colouring pages for kids

The IntelloKids colouring studio has 400+ cute pictures, with a set for every age from 3 to 10: big, simple shapes for the youngest and richer scenes as children grow. There are princesses, unicorns, animals, dinosaurs, the ocean, vehicles, space, food, nature and holidays. Children pick a colour and tap to fill each part, and their work is saved in their own colours, so finished pictures appear in colour in the catalogue. When they want to create something new, free drawing lets them paint anything they like.

Questions parents ask

Do I need to print the colouring pages?

No. Children colour directly on the screen by tapping each area, on a computer, tablet or phone, and their pictures are saved automatically.

Is the colouring studio safe for young children?

Yes. It is part of the IntelloKids kids’ area: no ads, no chat with strangers and no links to other websites.

Ready to start the adventure?

Create your parent account in a minute. One account covers up to 4 children.
